clips.title: The story
paras: Veron Amberstill is a dwarven ram breeder residing at Amberstill Ranch in eastern Dun Morogh. He tends to the rugged mountain rams that serve as the traditional mounts of Ironforge and offers them to skilled riders who have earned his trust.

Tucked away in the snow-dusted hills of eastern Dun Morogh, Veron Amberstill oversees the celebrated stock of Amberstill Ranch. Mountain rams are perfectly suited for Khaz Modan's treacherous slopes, sure-footed and thick-coated against the bite of mountain blizzards. Veron breeds and trains these beasts to carry dwarven scouts, mountaineers, and traveling adventurers. While he gladly provides standard and swift mounts to fellow dwarves, outsiders must prove their unwavering loyalty to the throne of Ironforge before he will part with any of his prized herd.
